data_point: AI or machine learning is core to their own product
run_when: Always, for companies still in the running.

prompt.task: Decide whether AI or machine learning is core to the company's own product.
prompt.definition: The product's main value comes from AI/ML, not a single AI feature.
yes_when: The product is an AI model, agent, assistant or ML-powered system at its heart
no_when: AI is one feature among many, or only marketing language
watch_out_for: Almost every site mentions AI now; keyword use alone is not enough

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

examples.input_excerpt: Linear: the product development system for teams. Now with AI triage.

output.reason: AI is an added feature, not the core product.
